subject: Recap + ask: network isolation options, SOC 2 evidence, vendor questionnaire
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Roberts <emily.roberts@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: network isolation options, SOC 2 evidence, vendor questionnaire

Emily — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum on the private/VPC evaluation. Notes from the call: 

- Compliance posture: ClearPath confirmed reliance on HIPAA controls and an in-progress SOC 2 Type II (expected Q4). You asked about our SOC 2 status, GDPR readiness for EU patient data, and encryption at rest/in transit.
- Deployment options: we walked through three models — hosted with dedicated tenancy, VPC peering (private control plane + customer-managed VPC), and fully air-gapped on-prem (longer lead time).
- Key asks you had: network diagrams, vendor security questionnaire, encryption/key management details, and an example deployment diagram for an air-gapped option.

Proposed next steps (from Redwood):
1) I will send our vendor security questionnaire and a short post-call notes PDF by EOD.
2) Can you share ClearPath's security requirements doc and an initial network diagram (if available) by 2025-09-10 so we can pre-map controls?
3) Let's schedule a technical architecture deep-dive (30–45m) the week of 2025-09-11 — suggested slots: 9/11 11:00–11:45 PT or 9/12 14:00–14:45 PT.

Attachments: 2025-09-03-postcall-notes.pdf (brief recap).

If that plan works, I’ll upload the questionnaire to the shared Drive and loop in Soojin to run the architecture call.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Emily Roberts <emily.roberts@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kevin Zhang <kevin.zhang@clearpathhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: network isolation options, SOC 2 evidence, vendor questionnaire

Ben — thanks for the thorough recap and the options overview. Quick replies inline:

- We will attach ClearPath_Security_Reqs.docx (includes minimum network/firewall rules and encryption expectations) — sending in this reply.
- SOC 2 status: we are on track for Type II in Q4; I can share our current audit contact if you need to request a bridge letter or interim evidence.
- Diagram: we have an internal network diagram (high-level) and I’ll include that with the doc. If you have a template for the air-gapped diagram you referenced that would help us align the terminology.

Request: can Redwood provide the vendor questionnaire as an editable spreadsheet? We prefer that format for procurement teams. Also please add any specific questions you need answered for KMS/HSM and key rotation windows.

Thanks — I’ll aim to get the packet to you by 2025-09-10. For the deep-dive, 9/11 11:00 PT works for Kevin and me.

Best,
Emily Roberts
Head of Compliance & Security Programs
ClearPath Health
emily.roberts@clearpathhealth.com | (650) 555-4120

Attachment: ClearPath_Security_Reqs.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Roberts <emily.roberts@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: network isolation options, SOC 2 evidence, vendor questionnaire

Emily — thanks, appreciate the quick turn. I’ve uploaded the vendor questionnaire in XLSX format and put a copy in the shared folder for ClearPath (link below). The spreadsheet has a short guidance tab (what evidence we typically accept) and questions scoped to: SOC 2 controls, network segregation, encryption/KMS, admin access controls, logging/retention, and air-gap readiness.

Drive link: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4_vendor_qs
Attachment (this email): redwood_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx

Action items I’ll take now:
- Marissa will prep a short SOC 2 evidence checklist you can use to request items from auditors (expect that by 9/8).
- Soojin will draft a deployment diagram template for both VPC and air-gapped flows and share it before the 9/11 call.

If you’d like us to pre-fill any fields in the XLSX to speed procurement, tell us which sections you want prioritized (we commonly pre-fill the encryption/KMS and network ports rows).

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Roberts <emily.roberts@clearpathhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: deployment diagram template + request for environment details

Hi Emily — following Ben’s upload, attaching the deployment_diagram_template.vsdx (Visio) that we’ll use in the technical deep-dive. A couple of items that will help us make the call productive: 

1) Which deployment model should we prioritize in the deep-dive: VPC (private control plane + customer-managed VPC) or fully air-gapped on-prem? If you’re unsure, tell us your risk tolerance ("no inbound connectivity to customer network" vs "private peering allowed").
2) For the VPC option, can you share the /16 or /20 CIDR ranges you typically allocate for HIPAA workloads (or a sample)? For air-gap, list the on-prem VLAN segmentation and whether you have an HSM/KMS appliance on-prem.
3) Logging & retention: what is the minimum audit log retention ClearPath requires for vendor systems (90d/1yr/7yrs)?

I’ll slot 9/11 11:00 PT on our calendars for the architecture call. If you prefer a deeper session for network/security ops only, we can add an extra 30 minutes.

Thanks — looking forward to the packet.

—
Soojin Lee
Principal Infrastructure Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: deployment_diagram_template.vsdx
